verdict.rationale: Documented renewal pricing and cancellation or transfer-out terms are a fair question for a registered-agent and entity-services provider like CT Corporation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only probe records: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into it. No CT Corporation page content on renewal charges, cancellation, or registered-agent transfer-out was retrieved, so the story has no supporting evidence.
